entries.title: System Architect and Lead (AI) - Eduvanz, Gurugram
bullets: Developed a Model Context Platform (MCP) for efficient hotel data search, improving query accuracy and response time for end users.
Created End to end CNN based face recognizer and BMI reader to identify fraudsters during video test.
Engineered a Multi-Agent Chatbot using LLMs and prompt chaining, allowing users to search, plan, and book hotels based on preferences such as location, budget, and comfort.
Created voice conversational agent to answer any query that user has corresponding to the insurance/banking plan that they opt for.
Reduced STT and TTS latency to less than 400 ms to support near real-time conversation.
Architected and created an end to end video creation platform using AI, thus creating videos without any intervention, but just a script or a topic. Scaled it to the creation of 1200 videos a day.
OpenSourced and scaled Embeddings creation and retrieval, which technically reduced cost from 330 $ to Zero.
Opensourced Text to speech pipeline, and scaled it to handle 120 requests per minute, hence moving out from paid service providers with less flexibility to free service and more flexibility.
Created an Evaluation pipeline to suggest which model to use in what use case.

entries.title: System Architect (AI) - TATA AIG, Mumbai
bullets: Spearheaded and operationalized generative AI RAG bot via Open Source, generating daily savings of 0.39 Lakhs INR, totaling nearly 1.4 CR annually.
Engineered and deployed speech-to-text, translation, transcription, and summarization applications for customer support and sales teams, enhancing customer retention.
Developed RFQ and Pic to quote application using MultiModal Generative AI application, aiding in product upselling.
Led a team of 4 in creating a cost-effective ADAS solution, resulting in over 1 million Rupees savings for the company while ensuring life-saving capabilities.
Automated the conventional "Video – MER" authentication system, integrating Value Added Services like BMI Calculation and Disability Detection. Yielded a direct cost reduction of 24 CR.
Pioneered in live video and audio processing, leveraging untapped potentials in this domain.
Conceptualized and implemented CNN-based health insurance products, anticipating needs and preventing over 10,000 potential fatalities. Solely orchestrated end-to-end pipeline development.
Invited by Tata Motors to consult and enhance their ADAS solution.

entries.title: Software Developer (AI) - Proxgy, Gurugram
bullets: Developed a fall detection system utilizing RNN, CNN, and Random Forest, deployed on Raspberry Pi integrated into smart helmets used by Adani and TATA, saving over 30 lives in hazardous conditions.
Engineered a highly optimized smart PPE Detection algorithm capable of handling 30+ simultaneous requests on a single server, leading to a significant 60% reduction in server usage.
Designed and implemented a Speech Detection model specialized in recognizing specific words, activating upon detection.
Integrated Face Detection technology with PPE Detection, minimizing the risk of injury and fatalities by identifying personnel and enforcing safety protocols.
Constructed a vehicle tracking model deployed on NVIDIA Jetson Nano, optimizing the model to INT8 precision for efficient performance.
Crafted a multi-stage Vehicle Type → Number Plate → Number Detection model, aiding the government in generating substantial revenue through penalties for traffic rule violators.

Spearheaded various NLP Test Augmentation methodologies encompassing PII, Text Augmentations, and Counterfactuals among others.
Established an End-to-End Recommendation System Pipeline integrating content-based and collaborative filtering approaches.

Utilized RNN and LSTMs to construct several predictive models for forecasting future stock prices.
